extracted.name: Lucy’s Mac and Corn
extracted.description: This creamy mac and cheese with corn makes a marvelous casserole when baked until golden brown.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a casserole dish.
Mix creamed corn, whole kernel corn, and uncooked macaroni together. Mix sliced butter and cheese into corn mixture; spoon into prepared dish. Cover.
Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Uncover, stir, and bake uncovered until golden brown, about 30 more minutes.
